summaries.en: Supervision is an open-source Python library that provides reusable tools for computer vision tasks, eliminating repetitive boilerplate code. It offers a unified API for loading, visualizing, and filtering detections from popular models like YOLO and SAM. Key strengths include dataset annotation, model evaluation, and post-processing utilities. Use it to streamline CV pipelines, from prototyping to production, without reinventing the wheel.
summaries.zh: Supervision 是一个开源的 Python 计算机视觉工具库，旨在消除重复的样板代码，让开发者专注于核心逻辑。它提供了统一的 API，支持加载、可视化和过滤来自 YOLO、SAM 等主流模型的检测结果。核心优势包括数据集标注、模型评估和结果后处理，并内置了丰富的实用工具。你可以用它快速搭建从原型到生产的视觉流水线，无需重复造轮子。无论是目标检测、实例分割还是定向边界框任务，Supervision 都能显著提升开发效率。

summaries.en: This project provides reference architectures for building GPU-accelerated vision agents that search and summarize video content. It combines large language models (LLMs) with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vision-language models (VLMs) to enable natural language queries over video data. Technically, it uses NVIDIA's AI frameworks to efficiently process video streams, extract key frames, and generate summaries. Developers can deploy these blueprints to create applications like automated video surveillance analysis, content moderation, or video archive search, leveraging GPU acceleration for real-time performance.
summaries.zh: 该项目提供了一套参考架构，用于构建GPU加速的视觉智能体，实现视频内容的搜索与摘要。它结合大语言模型（LLM）、检索增强生成（RAG）和视觉语言模型（VLM），让用户能用自然语言查询视频数据。技术上，它利用NVIDIA的AI框架高效处理视频流，提取关键帧并生成摘要。开发者可基于这些蓝图构建应用，如自动化视频监控分析、内容审核或视频档案搜索，借助GPU加速实现实时性能。核心优势在于将多模态AI与硬件加速结合，降低了视频分析应用的开发门槛。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
